tools.description: List the candidate actions on a window (id, kind, what it does). With `instruction`, Jev ranks them and the most likely come first with their probability `p`.

app.description: App name ("Calculator") or bundle id. Launched in the background if not running.

windowId.description: Window id. Default: the app's front-most titled window.

limit.description: Candidates to return (default 80, or 10 with an instruction).

tools.name: observe

tools.description: Perform one action on a window and verify its effect, then any steps in `then` the same way. Jev picks the action for `instruction` unless `candidateId` (from observe or an earlier act) is given. With dragTo ({candidateId} or {dx, dy} in screenshot pixels), drag that source control in the background; destructive controls under either actual endpoint require allowDestructive for both destination forms. Verify window-relative movement or state changes after a 0.3-second quiet interval within four settling snapshots; snapbacks are no_effect, unsettled results are unverified.

app.description: App name ("Calculator") or bundle id. Launched in the background if not running.

windowId.description: Window id. Default: the app's front-most titled window.

instruction.description: What this one action should do, e.g. 'press the 7 key' or 'type into the search field'.

text.description: Exact text to enter (fields, pop-ups, on-screen keypads). Never trimmed.

candidateId.description: Run this candidate instead of asking Jev.

dragTo.description: Drag candidateId to another candidate's centre, or by dx/dy window screenshot pixels.

allowDestructive.description: Permit an action that may not be undoable (delete, close, send …).

modifiers.description: Keys held during a click or toggle: shift-click extends a selection, cmd-click adds one item to it. The control must be visible on the window.

then.description: More steps on the same window, run in order after this one. The run stops at the first step that is not done or unverified; each step's result is in `steps`.

instruction.description: What this one action should do, e.g. 'press the 7 key' or 'type into the search field'.

text.description: Exact text to enter (fields, pop-ups, on-screen keypads). Never trimmed.

tools.name: act

tools.description: Return the text or value of the element Jev picks for `instruction` (e.g. 'the result shown on the display'), exactly as read from accessibility. A table or list is returned as `rows`.

app.description: App name ("Calculator") or bundle id. Launched in the background if not running.

windowId.description: Window id. Default: the app's front-most titled window.

tools.name: extract

tools.description: Capture an existing exact window (pid and windowId) or the primary screen (scope=screen). Return a PNG image by default and optionally save to absolute out without overwriting. Never activates apps.
tools.name: screenshot

tools.description: Start recording one existing pid/windowId to absolute out.mp4 using winrec (macOS 15+). Wait for capture readiness; one recording per MCP session. Never launches or activates an app.
tools.name: record_start

tools.description: Stop this session's recording and verify the finalized file. Return path, bytes and actual video durationSeconds. Shutdown also stops recording. Never overwrites existing files.
tools.name: record_stop

tools.description: Read system clipboard text and available types without pasting or changing focus.
tools.name: clipboard_read

tools.description: Write exactly one of text or absolute imagePath to the system clipboard and read back. Text requires exact equality. Image type readback is reported unverified because pixels cannot be read.
tools.name: clipboard_write

tools.description: Move and resize one existing pid/windowId in screen points. Read its frame again; return done only for exact equality, otherwise mismatch. No title-bar dragging or foreground fallback.
tools.name: set_window_frame

tools.description: Bind an existing exact pid/windowId and read a semantic_v2 browser snapshot with refs. Give tabId when several tabs exist. Requires exact binding and mutation_allowed; never prepares a browser.
tools.name: browser_state

tools.description: Assign 1..32 absolute regular files to an input[type=file] upload ref from browser_state using its targetId/tabId and original pid/windowId. Bypass native file pickers; refresh the snapshot afterward. Returns unverified because the driver provides assigned count without FileList readback.
tools.name: browser_upload

tools.description: Download through an exact ref from browser_state to absolute out without overwriting. Verify the completed download id and bytes in private staging. Driver MCP-host consent requirements and foreground_required refusals are preserved; no host approval is fabricated and no browser setup is performed.
tools.name: browser_download
